verdicts.note: Shot 1 opens on the cup and a bottle in soft focus; the gift itself is withheld until shot 3.
The host lifts and offers the bottle in shot 3: the gesture is the turn.
Every shot is in the same majlis; the doorway is part of it.
A hand sets the cup down in the first second; the bottle is visible behind it.
Every shot with the product has a size; the hero fills the frame.
No desert, no smoke around the bottle, no gold tray museum shot.
The tray and the cup are described as brass and white porcelain, nothing like the bottle.
A soft glass touch as the bottle meets the guest's palm in shot 3.
The insight is about the host's generosity; shot 3 shows the host lifting and offering the bottle to the guest's open palm: people carry the turn, not a spray demo.
The host never keeps the last guest waiting: he turns back toward him and offers the bottle with both hands.

output.summary: The prompt already keeps the bottle on screen and in the host's hands, and the turn reads in shot 3. Nothing to change.

rewrite.location: An empty traditional majlis at night with floor cushions, a brass tray and a carved wooden doorway.
rewrite.look: Warm low-key film look: amber and gold against deep brown shadows, soft grain; the amber bottle always reads against a darker background.
rewrite.lighting: Warm practical lamps from camera-left, deep soft shadows, a thin gold rim on glass and metal.

references.name: brass tray
references.description: A round, flat, hammered brass tray with a low rim.

references.name: coffee cup
references.description: A small white handleless Arabic coffee cup with a thin gold band.

shots.action: A hand sets the coffee cup down on the brass tray; the amber bottle stands in soft focus behind it.
shots.event: a hand sets the cup down
shots.sound: the soft clink of the cup, room tone

shots.action: At the carved doorway the host in a white thobe turns back toward the last guest.
The host lifts the bottle with both hands and offers it; the guest's open palm rises to take it.
shots.event: the host lifts and offers the bottle
shots.sound: strings swell under the oud, a soft glass touch on the palm

shots.action: The bottle stands alone on the brass tray, the gold cap catching the last light.
shots.camera: medium close-up, slow push-in, lower fifth empty
shots.sound: the music resolves on one held note

rewrite.audio: Room tone opens into a single oud line that builds with strings, with a soft glass touch as the bottle meets the guest's palm, and lands on a warm held note on the bottle.
